display.name: Repoctopus 工作流健康度
display.description: 团队 Change Run 的配置、完成状态、停留和返工。开始与终态统计使用各自的选入时间，面板时间范围左闭右开。

display.name: 启动 Run 总数
display.description: 窗口内启动的唯一 Workspace + Run。以开始时间选取样本。

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH
  toUInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000 AS window_start,
  toUInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000 AS window_end,
  facts AS (
    SELECT
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.correlation.workspace_id'] AS workspace, attributes_string['repoctopus.run.id'] AS run_id,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.correlation.change_id'] AS change_id, attributes_string['repoctopus.event.id'] AS event_id,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.event.sequence'] AS seq,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.event.type'] AS event_type,
      timestamp AS observed_at, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.correlation.phase'] AS phase, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.from_status'] AS from_status, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.from_phase'] AS from_phase,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.health_fact'] AS fact_kind, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.health_status'] AS new_health_status, coalesce(nullIf(new_health_status, ''), nullIf(attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.to_status'], ''), '') AS health_status,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.health_reason'] AS reason, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.health_configuration'] AS config,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.execution_mode'] AS mode, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.tdd_mode'] AS testing, attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.isolation'] AS isolation,
      attributes_string['repoctopus.observation.attribute.workflow_run_result'] AS run_result,
      mapContains(attributes_number, 'repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_total') AS has_rollbacks,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_total'] AS rb_total,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_build_to_open'] AS rb_build_to_open,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_build_to_design'] AS rb_build_to_design,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_verify_to_design'] AS rb_verify_to_design,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_verify_to_build'] AS rb_verify_to_build,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_archive_to_design'] AS rb_archive_to_design,
      attributes_number['repoctopus.observation.attribute.rollback_archive_to_verify'] AS rb_archive_to_verify
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= window_start AND timestamp < window_end
      AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN intDiv(window_start, 1000000000) - 1800 AND intDiv(window_end, 1000000000)
      AND resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN (
        SELECT fingerprint FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2_resource
        WHERE simpleJSONExtractString(labels, 'repoctopus.product.name') = 'repoctopus'
          AND seen_at_ts_bucket_start BETWEEN intDiv(window_start, 1000000000) - 1800 AND intDiv(window_end, 1000000000)
      )
      AND scope_name = 'repoctopus-runtime' AND workspace != '' AND run_id != '' AND change_id != '' AND event_id != ''
      AND (event_type IN ('run.started', 'change.lifecycle.transitioned', 'recovery.reconciled', 'run.resumed'))
  ),
  runs AS (
    SELECT workspace, run_id, any(change_id) AS change_id,
      countIf(event_type = 'run.started') > 0 AS started,
      argMaxIf(phase, (seq, event_id, fact_kind != ''), phase != '') AS latest_phase,
      argMaxIf(coalesce(nullIf(health_status, ''), if(event_type = 'run.started', 'running', nullIf(run_result, '')), 'unknown'), (seq, event_id, fact_kind != ''),
        event_type = 'run.started' OR health_status != '' OR run_result IN ('completed', 'failed')) AS latest_status,
      argMaxIf(coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), 'unknown'), (seq, event_id, fact_kind != ''),
        event_type = 'run.started' OR health_status != '' OR run_result IN ('completed', 'failed')) AS latest_reason,
      argMaxIf(observed_at, (seq, event_id), fact_kind = 'state' OR event_type = 'run.started' OR (fact_kind = '' AND health_status != '' AND from_status != health_status)) AS status_since,
      argMaxIf(observed_at, (seq, event_id), event_type = 'run.started' OR (from_phase != '' AND from_phase != phase)) AS phase_since,
      argMaxIf(tuple(config, mode, testing, isolation), (seq, event_id), config != '') AS latest_config,
      argMaxIf(run_result, (seq, event_id), run_result IN ('completed', 'failed')) AS terminal_result,
      argMaxIf(tuple(has_rollbacks, rb_total, rb_build_to_open, rb_build_to_design, rb_verify_to_design, rb_verify_to_build, rb_archive_to_design, rb_archive_to_verify), (seq, event_id, has_rollbacks),
        run_result = 'completed') AS rollback_counts
    FROM facts
    GROUP BY workspace, run_id
  )
SELECT toFloat64(countIf(started)) AS runs FROM runs
